announcement.title: GLOBAL TASK FORCE OVERLORD // OPERATIONAL ASSET STANDARDS
announcement.message: Ensure all packages marked REQUIRED FOR ALL or REQUIRED FOR CORE (for CORE Roster pilots) are deployed and up to date prior to joining official GTFO servers.

assets.name: GTFO Airfield Lighting Mod (Runway, PAPI, Approach & Floodlights)
assets.description: Custom airfield lighting assets for DCS World created for Global Task Force Overlord. Provides Mission Editor placeable static objects including an 856m Approach-Light Array, 80ft Red/Green Runway Threshold Bar, PAPI-4 Left/Right assemblies, 12m Parking Floodlight Poles with red obstruction beacons, and Elevated/Flush Omnidirectional & Directional fixtures.
assets.author: pschilly // Global Task Force Overlord
changelog: Includes 856m Approach-Light Array, 80ft Runway Threshold Bar, PAPI4 Left/Right v13, and 12m Parking Floodlight Pole
Includes Elevated & Flush Omni-Directional and Directional fixtures (Blue, Green, Red, White)
Uses Git Blob SHA-1 differential sync into Saved Games\DCS\Mods\tech\GTFOAirfieldLighting

assets.name: GTFO Complete Official Livery Repository Bundle (All Airframes)
assets.description: Full repository synchronization of https://github.com/pschilly/gtfo-liveries into Saved Games\DCS\Liveries. Uses Git Blob SHA-1 verification to skip unchanged files and only download new or updated textures.
assets.author: pschilly // Global Task Force Overlord
changelog: Synchronizes the entire pschilly/gtfo-liveries repository directly into Saved Games\DCS\Liveries
